question: ______ and Nitin Gadkari inaugurated the 81st annual session of the Indian Roads Congress in Lucknow in October 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Yogi Adityanath**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Yogi Adityanath, the Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh, and Nitin Gadkari, the Union Minister of Road Transport and Highways, inaugurated the 81st annual session of the Indian Roads Congress in Lucknow on October 8, 2022.The session was held at the Indira Gandhi Pratishthan in Lucknow.
